free.a: No, TryJob is free for students. Universities and companies fund the platform by contract.

time.a: The scenario runs in real time from 09:00 to 18:00 Tashkent time, with lunch 13:00–14:00. There is no pause: tasks arrive on schedule and deadlines count in working minutes. No work on weekends or public holidays.

companies.q: Are the companies in scenarios real?
companies.a: No, every company, client and number is made up. The situations and tasks are built like real work, though.

grading.a: AI grades each answer against predefined criteria (a rubric), and the mentor explains what to improve. Each task allows up to 3 attempts; the last one counts.

verify.q: How can a certificate be verified?
verify.a: Scan the QR code on the certificate or enter its TJ-XXXX-XXXX code in the form on this page. The page shows whether it is valid or revoked.

privacy.a: Companies see your scores and competencies only if you turn on "Open to work". Your university also sees only results. Your answers and chats are never shown to anyone.

cta.title: Your first workday is waiting
cta.subtitle: Sign up, pick a scenario and start today.
